items.exampleEn: Being a goalkeeper is the hardest job on the team.
items.exampleZh: 當守門員是隊上最難的工作。

items.exampleEn: Our school's handball team won the city cup.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校的手球隊贏得了全市盃賽冠軍。

items.exampleEn: You need strong wind for windsurfing.

items.exampleZh: 極限運動需要特別的訓練。

items.exampleEn: Ice hockey players wear helmets and thick gloves.
items.exampleZh: 冰上曲棍球選手戴安全帽和厚手套。

items.exampleEn: Ice skating takes a lot of practice.
The school's sports day is next Friday.
items.exampleZh: 學校的運動會在下星期五。

items.sentenceEn: The goalkeeper saved three shots in the first half.
items.sentenceZh: 守門員在上半場擋下了三次射門。

items.audioEn: Ice skating lessons are on Saturday at ten, and they cost fifteen dollars.
items.audioZh: 溜冰課在星期六十點，費用是十五元。

items.sentenceEn: Extreme sports can be dangerous, so wear a helmet.
items.sentenceZh: 極限運動可能很危險，所以要戴安全帽。

items.sentenceEn: Ice hockey is a fast and exciting game.
items.sentenceZh: 冰上曲棍球是一種快速又刺激的比賽。

items.stemEn: Our ____ jumped and stopped the ball just before it went into the net.
items.stemZh: 我們的守門員一躍而起，在球進網前擋了下來。

items.stemEn: In ____, players throw a ball into the other team's goal.
items.stemZh: 在手球比賽中，球員把球丟進對方的球門。

items.passageEn: Our school's winter sports week was a big success. On Monday, everyone went ice skating on the frozen lake near the school. On Tuesday, the ice hockey team played against the teachers, and the goalkeeper was our math teacher! On Wednesday, students played handball in the gym. Some brave students also tried extreme sports, like snowboarding jumps with a coach. In summer, the school plans to offer windsurfing lessons at a nearby resort.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的冬季運動週辦得很成功。星期一，大家到學校附近結冰的湖上溜冰。星期二，冰上曲棍球隊和老師們比賽，守門員是我們的數學老師！星期三，學生在體育館打手球。有些勇敢的學生還嘗試了極限運動，例如在教練帶領下玩滑雪板跳躍。夏天時，學校打算在附近的度假村開風帆衝浪課。

questions.questionZh: 星期二冰上曲棍球隊和誰比賽？
學校夏天打算開什麼課？

items.promptZh: 我們去結冰的湖上溜冰。
referenceEn: We went ice skating on the frozen lake.
We went ice skating on a frozen lake.
rubricZh: ice skating 表示「溜冰」，例如 go ice skating 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 extreme sports 造一個句子，說說你對極限運動的看法。
referenceEn: I think extreme sports are too dangerous for me.
I would like to try extreme sports one day.
rubricZh: extreme sports 表示「極限運動」，例如 try extreme sports 等說法
說的是自己的看法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
